summary: Verified component-split refactor of HoursTable, PayrollAdmin, EquipmentAdmin. All 8 listed flows verified via Playwright UI tests against the live preview URL. Login + push-gate dismiss works. All extracted modals/panels open with correct data-testids, fields fill, and close handlers work. No regressions detected. Lint clean across all new files.

verified_flows.details: generate-links-btn opens modal; 7 copy-link-* + 7 link-* inputs rendered; copy click works; Zamknij closes.

advance-cell-{id} click opens modal; advance-total, new-advance-amount, new-advance-note rendered; Dodaj button visible; Zamknij closes. Screenshot confirms full layout (Suma zaliczek, Brak zaliczek state, form).
penalty-cell-{id} click opens modal; penalty-total, new-penalty-amount, new-penalty-desc, add-penalty-btn all rendered; Zamknij closes. Image lightbox path exists in code (penalty-image-{id}).
UserPlus button opens payroll-add-modal; payroll-add-name, payroll-add-phone fields fill correctly; Anuluj cancels.
13 History icon rows; click opens payroll-audit-modal; Zamknij closes.
'Weryfikuj godziny' opens payroll-diagnostics-modal; diagnostics-ok visible (clean state); diagnostics-close closes.
Enabled transfer-btn-{id} opens transfer-from-warehouse-modal; transfer-foreman-select has 5 options; transfer-qty-input + transfer-submit-btn + close-transfer-modal all rendered.
Panel renders with 2 scrap-* items (testid scrap-*); toggle Pokaz/Ukryj works.

critical_code_review_comments: HoursTable.js is still 1170 lines — consider further splitting (e.g., extract the assignment-mode panel and the main hours grid table) for future maintainability, but not blocking.
EquipmentAdmin.js still 1188 lines and PayrollAdmin.js still 862 lines — acceptable post-split but trending high; can be re-evaluated next refactor cycle.
Google Maps API key error appears in console on dashboard (ApiProjectMapError). Unrelated to this refactor but worth flagging — invalid/missing key for the Maps integration.
data-testid coverage on extracted modals is comprehensive; no gaps found.
seed_data_creation: None. Used existing seed data (13 employees, 7 equipment rows, 5 enabled transfer buttons, 5 foreman options).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Refactor split of HoursTable/PayrollAdmin/EquipmentAdmin into hours/, payroll/, equipment-admin/ subfolders is complete and verified. Triggers for HoursTable modals: generate-links-btn (links), advance-cell-{id} (advances - click without force=True), penalty-cell-{id} (penalties - click without force=True). Equipment transfer-btn is disabled when available_quantity=0; use ':not([disabled])' selector. Push notification gate appears on first login per session — dismiss via text 'Przypomnij mi jutro'.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no regressions found. Initial sub-test miss on advance/penalty cells was a test-script issue (force=True bypassed onClick of <td> wrapper); corrected by using normal click() and confirmed both modals render correctly.
